mathematical_contract.ray_selection: The kernel tries exact directions (1,m) from a bounded integer set larger than the endpoint count. A candidate is accepted only when the retained algebraic point has a decided nonzero homogeneous side sign against every endpoint; an endpoint equal to the point is Boundary.
mathematical_contract.boundary_incidence: For query coordinates Nx(a)/D(a), Ny(a)/D(a) and rational curve homogeneous coordinates X(t),Y(t),W(t), the two bivariate equations D(a)X(t)-Nx(a)W(t)=0 and D(a)Y(t)-Ny(a)W(t)=0 are counted on t in [0,1] by Hypersolve's selected local-field common-fiber authority. A counted root or identically-zero/endpoint fiber is Boundary; unsupported coefficient fields remain explicit.
mathematical_contract.winding: Each same-sign-weight rational Bezier is tested in homogeneous coordinates. Bernstein sign hulls exclude cells wholly on one ray side or wholly behind the query. A sign-changing cell wholly ahead contributes its oriented crossing. Otherwise exact de Casteljau subdivision at 1/2 continues; a crossing exactly at the shared midpoint is owned once from its before/after signs, and a grazing tangency contributes zero.
mathematical_contract.fill_and_roles: Per-loop EvenOdd or NonZero winding is decided first; certified material/hole roles then compose the CurveRegion2 signed depth through the existing authoritative classification graph.
mathematical_contract.optimization: A predicate evaluator refines its retained isolator by exactly one STRICT bisection, reused across all geometric signs. A common strict Bernstein-control sign over that bracket proves only nonzero signs. Mixed hulls and every equality fall through to the complete algebraic-root evaluator.
mathematical_contract.policy: The optional interval proof always executes under STRICT and therefore cannot consume an APPROXIMATE_512 terminal. The authoritative fallback alone receives the caller's policy. STRICT accepts exact proofs only; APPROXIMATE_512 may terminate only at the shared Hyperlimit 512-bit equality boundary while retaining exact geometry.

benchmark.primary_method: release unit-test executables pinned to CPU 11; seven perf-stat process repetitions; deterministic instructions and branches are the primary comparison

nonlinear_classifier_matrix.workload: both-policy curved-cap inside/outside classification, exact parabola boundary incidence, a dyadic subdivision-midpoint crossing, a non-dyadic grazing tangency, and the retained affine/cusp matrix

tuning.selection: One shared strict bisection minimizes measured deterministic work; deeper eager refinement costs more than the GCD fallbacks it avoids.

competitive_context.method: current all-feature comparative executable pinned to CPU 11; eleven adaptive samples targeted at 100 ms; fixture construction excluded; finite libraries are throughput targets rather than guarantee-equivalent peers
competitive_context.interpretation: The binary64 competitors cannot retain the selected algebraic query field, certify exact boundary GCD incidence, or preserve STRICT/APPROXIMATE_512 outcome semantics. They remain important throughput targets.

memory.tool: Heaptrack direct release-unit-test traces; heaptrack_print summaries are authoritative
memory.interpretation: Reusing one refined proof bracket removes 127,653 allocation calls and 34,420 analyzer-classified temporaries. Peak live heap rises by 174.2 KiB because the refined retained-root/Sturm state remains cached for the evaluator; this is accepted under the stated performance-first priority and remains explicit memory debt.

release_size.method: matched default-feature and no-default-feature curve_region_boolean_batch release executables against the semantic checkpoint and its parent, with identical live dependency revisions
release_size.interpretation: The fast proof removes 296 linked text bytes from the semantic implementation. The complete nonlinear classifier costs 20.9 KiB of default-feature text versus its parent, while the minimal build remains text-byte-identical and receives only non-loadable metadata movement. No compatibility shim or second classification engine is linked.
